persona: Priya, a community volunteer with no technical background
plain_request: Our neighborhood needs a page where people can post local events and others can RSVP. It has to be reliable — I can't have it losing people's sign-ups.
title: neighborhood event board with RSVPs
critical_rationale: The user asks for 'reliable, can't lose sign-ups'; world-class delivery enforces Node backend correctness (transaction boundaries, typed errors, structured logging, fetch timeouts) from the node namespace — invisible plumbing the user cannot specify.
acceptance_criteria: A resident can post an event with a title, date, and location
A resident can RSVP and the RSVP is never lost even if two people sign up at once
The page is keyboard- and screen-reader-accessible
Backend errors are logged and surfaced as a friendly message, never a crash
